AIChatApp Docker And Environment Reference

- In Docker, services should talk to container addresses and container ports on the Docker network.
- For a host SQL Server from a Windows containerized app, use host.docker.internal.
- For a SQL Server container on the same Docker network, use the SQL container name such as mssqlserver.

Typical Docker-sensitive settings:
- ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection
- JwtSettings__SecretKey
- ApiKey.Settings__Keys__0
- EmailSettings__AppPassword

Typical local development pattern:
- API runs locally on https://localhost:7093 and http://localhost:5157
- Gateway runs locally on https://localhost:7067 and http://localhost:5031
- Web runs locally on https://localhost:7033 and http://localhost:5143

Gateway development forwarding:
- Chat traffic is forwarded to the local API
- Auth traffic is forwarded to the local API
- Chat history traffic is forwarded to the local API
